# Issues moved from millsks/pixi-sbom

On 2026-10-11 the issues still open in [millsks/pixi-sbom](https://github.com/millsks/pixi-sbom) were copied here with
their milestones, labels and comments, and the originals were closed with a link to the copy. Closed issues and
every pull request stay in millsks/pixi-sbom, which is kept as an archive; the changelog links releases up to 1.11.0 there.
